moves.name: Skitter
moves.notes: Cannot be used on consecutive turns. Always used at the start of combat. The Exoskeleton in slot 1 starts with this move. Slot 4 starts in a random branch that can also choose this move. In that branch, "Skitter" and "Mandibles" have equal weight and cannot repeat consecutively.

moves.name: Mandibles
moves.notes: Cannot be used on consecutive turns. Always followed by Enrage. Always used at the start of combat.

moves.name: Enrage
moves.notes: Always used at the start of combat. The Exoskeleton in slot 3 starts with this move; it also always follows "Mandibles". Afterward it enters the "Skitter"/"Mandibles" random branch.

enemy.pattern_text: Shows this enemy's repeating move order. Starts with Hard to Kill 9 Hard to Kill X: Reduce all damage taken and HP loss to X.
